relevance.rationale: JOIN CONFIRMED from the arXiv title page (arXiv:math/0403224v1, math.GT): subject, identifier and single-author form all match the seeded entry. CITATION STATUS: BIB ORPHAN. A repo-wide grep for the key outside references.ts, the ledger and library/sm-uploads-intake.json returns ZERO hits - no .md \cite, no .ts cites[], no Lean -- Ref:. The reference entry's own note concedes it ('relevant to the corpus's colored-Jones tower infrastructure, not to the SM appendix directly'). On merits: the paper proves the N-colored Jones of the torus knot T(s,t) satisfies a second-order q-difference equation (first order for T(2,2m+1)), derives the A-polynomial from it, and gives a q-hypergeometric expression in the T(2,2m+1) case. The folio's knot programme is built entirely on HYPERBOLIC knots and links (4_1, 5_2, 6_2, Borromean rings); torus knots are non-hyperbolic, so the volume / Stokes / 1-loop machinery does not apply to them and there is no torus-knot colored-Jones consumer anywhere in the corpus. Tangential: same field, no result this folio currently consumes. Scope-(a): a statement about this document against the corpus as it stands, not a claim that torus-knot recurrences are excluded from the framework.
